decision.detail: Flatten scheduler unconfirmed for 10+ consecutive sessions (Sep 17–Sep 28). Day plan explicitly blocks all new entries until a human confirms the flatten scheduler is armed. All other gates also fail independently: (1) Broad-tape unlock fails — NVDA below VWAP ($230.29 < $230.49 VWAP); (2) INTC below VWAP ($116.34 < $116.70), rel_vol 0.97 < 1.5 minimum, no ORB breakout; (3) NVDA rel_vol 1.14 < 1.5, no ORB breakout; (4) BAC below VWAP ($54.885 < $55.15), rel_vol 1.03 < 1.5; (5) 187 min past open exceeds 90-min ORB entry window (playbook rule). No positions to manage. Zero open positions, zero open orders.
